skill.summary: Knowledge management for AI agents. Store and retrieve project context before any work. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-s...

latestVersion.changelog:
byTEROVER v1.0.0

- Initial release of the byterover skill for AI agent knowledge management.
- Supports storing and retrieving project context to enhance agent performance.
- Integrates access to 50+ models across providers (image, video, TTS, STT, music, chat, web search, email, SMS, and more).
- Features include direct model invocation by ID or smart routing to select the best model for a task.
- Provides unified API interface with Bash example commands for common AI/automation workflows.
